senses.gloss: f. (b. h.; = עממית, v. עֲמָם) nationality, community; (sub. איש) m. country-man, associate, fellow.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 30a:14">Shebu. 30ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>עמיתך</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 19:15">Lev. XIX, 15</cite>) <he>עַם שֶׁאִתְּךָ וכ׳</he> the people joined to thee in the Law and in duties.
<cite ref="Leviticus 19:15">Ib.</cite> <he>עולא חבירנו ע׳ וכ׳</he> ‘Ula, our friend, fellowman in the Law &c.
